title: The AI Edge: Seizing the AI opportunity
description:
COLD OPEN: A staggering 85% of businesses globally risk being left behind if they don't harness AI within the next five years.

INTRO & RUNDOWN: I'm Alex, and this is the AI Edge. Here are the top 5 stories shaping our world. 

Story 1: Seizing the AI opportunity—why businesses must act now to stay competitive. 

Story 2: China resets the path to comprehensive AI governance, as reported by the East Asia Forum. 

Story 3: Inside JetBrains—the innovative company reshaping how the world writes code
